fields.label: Products per page
fields.name: shop_products_per_page
fields.instructions: How many products load before the "Load more" button.

fields.label: Stockist page
fields.name: shop_stockist_page
fields.instructions: "Find a local stockist" buttons link here with the product pre-selected.

fields.label: "Ask our experts" link
fields.name: shop_experts_link
fields.instructions: Where the product page's "Ask our experts" link goes. The product ID is appended as ?product=.

fields.label: Google Maps API key
fields.name: shop_google_maps_key
fields.instructions: Used by the stockist finder map and geocoding.

fields.label: Google Geocoding key (server)
fields.name: shop_google_geocoding_key
fields.instructions: Optional. A browser key restricted by HTTP referrer is rejected by the Geocoding web service — use a second key restricted by IP (or unrestricted) here. Leave empty to reuse the Maps key.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: shop_knowledge_heading
fields.instructions: Default for the band above the footer on product pages. Products can override it.
